title: Voice AI Assistant for Internal SOP Questions, Always in Sync
summary: Employees ask procedure questions out loud or by chat and get concise answers from the latest SOPs, which update themselves automatically.
headline: Ask your SOPs out loud. Get the answer.
seoTitle: Voice AI Assistant for Company SOPs
problem: Staff lost time searching long SOP documents, and answers drifted out of date whenever a procedure changed.
solution: I built a conversational agent on a retrieval-augmented knowledge base. An n8n pipeline fetches the SOPs from SmartSuite on a schedule, cleans and structures them, then deletes and recreates the knowledge base so the agent always answers from the current version.
highlights: Old knowledge base replaced on each run, so answers stay current
role: Sole engineer. I built the agent, wrote its prompts and guardrails, and built the document synchronisation pipeline.

results.label: One place for staff to get SOP answers quickly
Knowledge stays up to date with no manual re-indexing
More consistent guidance for new and existing staff
